z-m-19-02.title: Ingabe kukhona i-quadratic equation eyodwa kuphela enezixazululo ezimbili ezingu-2 no--5?
z-m-19-02.topic: Ukwenza i-quadratic equation kusukela ezixazululweni ezimbili ezinikeziwe, nesimo sokuyilungisa ibe yinye
z-m-19-02.goal: Khombisa ngezibonelo eziningana ukuthi noma kunikezwa izixazululo ezimbili, i-quadratic equation ayilungiswa ibe yinye, bese uhlunga ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi olwengeziwe olulungisa i-equation ibe yinye nokuthi yiluphi ulwazi olungelona olusha.
z-m-19-02.material: USua wabuza umbuzo. "Ngitshele i-quadratic equation izixazululo zayo (izimpande) ezingamanani amabili u-x=2 no-x=−5." I-quadratic equation ibhalwa ax²+bx+c=0 (a≠0), futhi ngezansi, u-a, b, c bayizinombolo eziphelele. (Funda u-x² njengo-"x squared" no-−5 njengo-"minus 5".)
z-m-19-02.thinking.0: Ukuhlulela ukuthi ulwazi olunikeziwe luyanela yini
z-m-19-02.thinking.1: Ukwenza izibonelo eziningana ezanelisa izimo nokuthola ubudlelwano phakathi kwazo
z-m-19-02.thinking.2: Ukuhlunga ukuthi isimo esengeziwe siwulwazi olusha ngempela yini
z-m-19-02.prereq.0: Incazelo yezixazululo ze-quadratic equation, nokuhlola ngokufaka izixazululo
z-m-19-02.s.s1.prompt: I-quadratic equation ilungiswa ibe yinye ulwazi olungu-'izixazululo zingu-2 no--5' kuphela?
z-m-19-02.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ngokwenza i-quadratic equation eyodwa enezixazululo ezingu-2 no--5 (isb. andisa u-(x−2)(x+5)=0), bese ufaka izixazululo ukuhlola ukuthi iba ngu-0.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi ungenza yini i-equation enezixazululo ezifanayo kodwa ama-coefficient ahlukile kunalo owalenza, bese ufaka izixazululo ukuhlola.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.o.a: Ilungisiwe. Uma izixazululo zifana, i-equation ingaba ifanayo kuphela
z-m-19-02.s.s1.r.a: Awuzange uhlole ukuthi kungaba khona ama-equation amaningi anezixazululo ezifanayo. Ngemuva kokwenza i-equation eyodwa enezixazululo ezingu-2 no--5, zama ukushintsha ama-coefficient.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.o.b: Ayinqunyiwe. Kodwa kuphela ama-equation anezixazululo ezifanayo amabili asho uphawu luka-a oluguqulwe
z-m-19-02.s.s1.r.b: Kulungile ukuthi i-equation ayinqunywa ibe yinye, kodwa akuphawu kuphela oluguquka. Yenza nama-equation lapho usayizi luka-a uguqulelwe ku-2 noma 3, bese ufaka izixazululo.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.o.c: Ayinqunyiwe. Kungase kube khona ama-equation amaningi anezixazululo ezifanayo
z-m-19-02.s.s1.o.d: Inqunyiwe. I-equation evela ekwandiseni u-(x−2)(x+5)=0, eyenziwe ngezixazululo ezimbili, iyimpendulo
z-m-19-02.s.s1.r.d: Ungenza i-equation eyodwa ngokwandisa u-(x−2)(x+5)=0, kodwa i-equation eyenziwe ngokuyiphindaphinda ngenombolo engesiyo u-0 nayo inezixazululo ezifanayo. Faka izixazululo ku-equation enama-coefficient ahlukile.
z-m-19-02.s.s1.explain: Uma ufaka u-x=2 no-x=−5 ku-x²+3x−10=0, kokubili kunika u-0, futhi u-2x²+6x−20=0, ephindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili zalena equation ngo-2, nayo igcina izixazululo zombili. Ngakho izixazululo zodwa azinquli i-equation ibe yinye. Esinyathelweni esilandelayo, sizokwenza ama-equation ngokwethu ukubona ukuthi mangaki angenzeka.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza ama-quadratic equation angu-3 ahlukile ax²+bx+c=0 anakho kokubili u-x=2 no-x=−5 njengezixazululo. (U-a, b, c bayizinombolo eziphelele futhi −9≤a≤9)
z-m-19-02.s.s2.hint.0: Thatha ukwandiswa kwe-equation u-(x−2)(x+5)=0 eyenziwe ngezixazululo njengendawo yokuqala, bese uhlola ukuthi yiziphi izinguquko kuyo ezishiya izixazululo njengoba zinjalo.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ama-coefficient (a, b, c) ama-equation owenzile ethebuleni bese uqhathanisa ukuthi u-b no-c baguquka kanjani kanye no-a njengoba u-a eguquka.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Iyi-quadratic equation futhi ama-coefficient ahambisana nezimo.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.fail.c1: U-a akumele abe ngu-0 futhi kumele abe yinombolo ephelele kusuka ku-−9 kuya ku-9, futhi u-b no-c kumele babe yizinombolo eziphelele nabo.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Faka u-x=2. Uhlangothi lwesobunxele luba ngu-0?
z-m-19-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Faka u-x=−5. Uhlangothi lwesobunxele luba ngu-0?
z-m-19-02.s.s2.explain: Ukufaka u-x=2 no-x=−5 kunika u-4a+2b+c=0 no-25a−5b+c=0, futhi kulawa ma-equation amabili uthola u-b=3a, c=−10a. Ngakho uma unquma u-a, u-b no-c balandela, futhi ama-equation angenzeka yilawo luka-x²+3x−10=0 izinhlangothi zombili ziphindaphindwe ngenombolo efanayo engesiyo u-0.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Ubudlelwano obuthini phakathi kwama-equation owenzile? Bhala ukuthi ama-coefficient aguquke kanjani, ufaka izinombolo.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Beka u-a, b, c kwabambili kuma-equation owenzile eceleni komunye bese uwaqhathanisa ngokuhlukanisa (isilinganiso).
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Faka u-x=2 ku-equation eyenziwe ngokuphindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili luka-x²+3x−10=0 ngenombolo efanayo.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Uhlole ukuthi ubudlelwano obufanayo busebenza kuwo wonke ama-equation owenzile?
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Uchaze, ngisho nangomugqa owodwa, ukuthi kungani lobo budlelwano abuguquli izixazululo?
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Uma uphindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili luka-x²+3x−10=0 ngo-2, iba ngu-2x²+6x−20=0. Wonke ama-coefficient akhule ngesici esifanayo futhi izixazululo ziyafana.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Kuma-equation engiwenzile, uma u-a engu-1, 2, −1, u-b wayengu-3a no-c engu--10a. Ngiphindaphinde yonke i-equation ngenombolo efanayo, ngakho izixazululo ezimbili azishintshi.
z-m-19-02.s.s2.because.model.2: Uma ngishintsha u-a abe ngu-1, 2, −1, u-b walandela njengo-3a no-c njengo--10a. Isilinganiso sama-coefficient sihlala sifana, 1:3:−10.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.prompt: USua ufuna ukwengeza isimo ukulungisa i-equation ibe yinye. Ngaphezu kwesimo sokuthi izixazululo zingu-2 no--5, khetha zonke izimo ezilungisa i-quadratic equation ax²+bx+c=0 (u-a, b, c bayizinombolo eziphelele) ibe yinye.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.hint.0: Usebenzisa ubudlelwano u-b=3a, c=−10a, guqula isimo ngasinye sibe yisisho esisebenzisa u-a kuphela.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.hint.1: Bala ukuthi u-a ohlangabezana nesimo esiguquliwe munye ncamashi noma baningi.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.a: U-a=1, 2, 3 ... bonke basala, ngakho akulungiswa kube kunye. Ukunquma uphawu kuphela akunquli usayizi wenombolo ephindaphindwayo.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.b: Uma uphutha ubudlelwano u-c=−10a, kunzima ukubona ukuthi lesi simo sinquma u-a.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.c: Uma izixazululo ezimbili zingu-2 no--5, isamba sesivele singu--3. Uthathe ukuphinda ulwazi osenikeziwe njengolwazi olusha.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.d: Uma ufaka ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-a, b, c futhi ubhale u-a+b+c ngohlamvu olulodwa, ungabona ukuthi lesi simo sinquma u-a.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.o.e: U-a, b, c bonke abasiyo u-0
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.e: Uma u-a engesiyo u-0, khona-ke u-b=3a no-c=−10a nabo abasiyo u-0, ngakho lokhu kusebenza kakade. Akuyona ulwazi olusha.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.r.f: Uma u-a=1, khona-ke u-b=3 no-c=−10 banqunyiwe. Kubonisa isakhiwo lapho, uma i-coefficient eyodwa inqunyiwe, ezinye zilandela.
z-m-19-02.s.s3.explain: Uma izixazululo ziyi-2 no-−5, khona (a, b, c)=(a, 3a, −10a). Uma c=−10a=−10, khona a=1; uma a=1, khona (1, 3, −10); uma a+b+c=a+3a−10a=−6a=−6, khona a=1; konke kulungisa njengesisodwa. Isimo sokuthi a iyiphozithivu sishiya a njengo-1, 2, 3 ..., futhi izitatimende zokuthi isamba sezixazululo ezimbili singu-−3 nokuthi onke ama-coefficient awawona u-0 bezivele zaziwa, ngakho azikwazi ukuncishisa isibalo.

z-m-19-01.s.s2.ok.c1: a no-b kuyizinombolo zemvelo ezihlangabezana nemibandela.
z-m-19-01.title: Ingabe u-√a+√b ulingana no-√(a+b)?
z-m-19-01.topic: Ngomumo muni isamba sezinombolo ezimbili ezinezimpande zesikwele singabhalwa?
z-m-19-01.goal: Khombisa ngesibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo ukuthi '√a+√b=√(a+b)' ayihlali isebenza, uthole wena amapheya (a, b) lapho isamba sezimpande zesikwele ezimbili senziwa lula sibe umumo owodwa we-radical, bese ubhala isici sabo esifanayo ngamagama.
z-m-19-01.material: UMinjae wathi, "Ukubhala isamba sezimpande zesikwele ezimbili, wengeze nje izinombolo ngaphansi kwezimpawu ze-radical bese ubhala njengenye. Isibonelo, u-√2+√3 ungu-√5." Ngezansi, ake u-a no-b bobabili babe yiphozithivu, futhi isitatimende sikaMinjae sibe ngu-'√a+√b=√(a+b)' (root a plus root b equals the root of the whole a plus b). Ireferensi: √2≈1.414, √3≈1.732, √5≈2.236.
z-m-19-01.thinking.0: Ukuhlola isitatimende ngezinombolo ezithile nokuqonda amandla esibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo
z-m-19-01.thinking.1: Ukwenza izibonelo eziningana ezanelisa izimo nokuthola isakhiwo esifanayo
z-m-19-01.prereq.1: Ukuthola amanani acishe abe aqondile ezimpande zesikwele nge-calculator
z-m-19-01.s.s1.prompt: Ukuhlola isitatimende sikaMinjae, sifaka a=9, b=16. U-√9=3 no-√16=4, ngakho u-√9+√16=7, futhi u-√(9+16)=√25=5. Iyiphi indlela efaneleke kakhulu yokuhumusha lo mphumela?
z-m-19-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bala u-√9+√16 no-√(9+16) ngokuhlukile, ubabhale eceleni komunye, bese uqhathanisa.
z-m-19-01.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi zingaki izibonelo ezingasebenzi okumele zibe khona ukuze u-'kuyasebenza kuzo zonke u-a, b' kube yiphutha.
z-m-19-01.s.s1.o.a: Leli yicala elilodwa kuphela eliphosile, futhi cishe lizosebenza kwabanye u-a, b
z-m-19-01.s.s1.r.a: Isitatimende esithi 'kuzo zonke izinombolo eziphozithivu u-a, b' siphulwa yisibonelo esisodwa nje esingasebenzi. Ukuthatha esisodwa njengokungafani kufana nokuguqula isitatimende sibe ngu-'sivame ukulunga.'
z-m-19-01.s.s1.o.b: Kufanele uthole ezinye izibonelo ezimbalwa futhi uqhubeke uphosa ngaphambi kokuba usho ukuthi isitatimende siphosile
z-m-19-01.s.s1.r.b: Ukukhombisa ukuthi isitatimende silungile, akukho nani lezibonelo elanele, kodwa ukukhombisa ukuthi siphosile, isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo sanele. Uphatha amacala amabili ngendlela efanayo.
z-m-19-01.s.s1.o.c: U-7 no-5 bahlukile, ngakho lesi sitatimende asisebenzi kuzo zonke izinombolo eziphozithivu u-a, b
z-m-19-01.s.s1.o.d: U-9 no-16 bayizikwele eziphelele ngakho bakhethekile, ngakho lesi sivivinyo asikwazi ukusetshenziswa njengobufakazi
z-m-19-01.s.s1.r.d: Isitatimende sithi 'iphozithivu u-a, b,' ngakho izikwele eziphelele zifakiwe. Ukulahla isivivinyo ngoba amanani abukeka ekhethekile kukuvumela ugweme isibonelo esiphikisayo.
z-m-19-01.s.s1.explain: Uma isitatimende sithi 'njalo,' isibonelo esisodwa esingasebenzi (u-√9+√16=7, u-√25=5) sanele ukusiphula. Nokho, lokhu kusho kuphela 'lesi sitatimende asihlali silungile,' hhayi ukuthi akukho samba esingabhalwa njenge-radical eyodwa. Esinyathelweni esilandelayo sifuna amacala anjalo.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.prompt: Indlela kaMinjae iphosile, kodwa kukhona amacala lapho u-√a+√b enziwa lula abe ngumumo owodwa u-p√m (u-p, m izinombolo zemvelo). Thola amapheya angu-3 ahlukile (a, b) anjalo. Izimo: u-a no-b bayizinombolo zemvelo onu-2≤a<b≤200, futhi nga-a noma b akusiyo isikwele esiphelele (1, 4, 9, 16 ...).
z-m-19-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokukhetha noma yiliphi ipheya, njengo-a=5, b=7, uthole isamba nge-calculator, bese uhlola ukuthi leli nani lihlukaniswe ngo-√5 liyinombolo yemvelo yini.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala amapheya ambalwa aphumelele eceleni komunye bese ubheka ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-a no-b (inani lokuwengeza, ukuwaphindaphinda, noma ukuwahlukanisa).
z-m-19-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Akukho phakathi kuka-a no-b okuyisikwele esiphelele.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.fail.c2: U-a noma u-b uyisikwele esiphelele. Shintsha ube yinombolo engesona isikwele esiphelele.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.ok.c3: U-√a+√b wenziwa lula abe ngumumo owodwa u-p√m.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Kulo pheya, isamba asilulwa sibe umumo owodwa we-radical. Bhala u-√a no-√b ngamunye ngomumo wawo olula kakhulu eceleni komunye bese uqhathanisa.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo, u-√2+√8=√2+2√2=3√2, u-√3+√12=√3+2√3=3√3, u-√12+√27=2√3+3√3=5√3. Kuphela uma inombolo efanayo isala ngaphansi kwe-radical uma ilulwa ngangokunokwenzeka lapho zingahlanganiswa zibe eyodwa. Kumapheya anjalo, u-a×b uyisikwele esiphelele (2×8=16, 3×12=36, 12×27=324). Ngokuphambene, uma izinombolo ezisele ziyahluka, njengo-√5+√7, azikwazi ukuhlanganiswa zibe i-radical eyodwa.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Yini oyibonayo efanayo emapheya owathola? Futhi bhala, ufaka izinombolo, ukuthi kungani i-equation kaMinjae u-√a+√b=√(a+b) ingasebenzi kwelinye lamapheya owathola.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Kwelinye lamapheya owathola, bhala u-a no-b ngamunye njengo-(inombolo yemvelo)×√(inombolo encane).
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Thola amanani acishe abe aqondile luka-√a+√b no-√(a+b) nge-calculator bese uwaqhathanisa.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Uhlole ukuthi isici esifanayo osishilo ngempela sisebenza kuwo wonke amapheya owathola?
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ubonise ukuthi i-equation kaMinjae iphosile ngokuqhathanisa amanani amabili (isamba no-√(a+b))?
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.model.0: Ku-(2, 8), u-√8=2√2, ngakho u-√2+2√2=3√2. Lipheya lapho izinombolo ngaphansi kwe-radical zifana uma zilulwa. Kodwa u-√(2+8)=√10≈3.16 no-3√2≈4.24, ngakho amanani ayahluka, futhi i-equation kaMinjae ayisebenzi.
z-m-19-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Ukubheka u-(3, 12) no-(12, 27), umkhiqizo luka-a no-b uyisikwele esiphelele, njengo-3×12=36 no-12×27=324. Isibonelo, u-√3+√12=3√3≈5.20, kodwa u-√15≈3.87, ngakho abalingani.

z-m-19-03.title: Kwenzekani kokuncane kakhulu uma ibanga lika-x lishintsha?
z-m-19-03.topic: Okuphezulu nokuncane kakhulu kwemisebenzi ye-quadratic enebanga lika-x elinqunyiwe
z-m-19-03.goal: Uma kunikezwa ibanga elisha lika-x, gcina noma uvuselele isinqumo sakho ngokuncane kakhulu komsebenzi we-quadratic, bese wenza wena ibanga lapho i-vertex ingaphandle kwebanga futhi uthole ukuncane kwalo kakhulu.
z-m-19-03.material: U-Doha ubhale kabusha umsebenzi we-quadratic y=x²−4x+1 njengo-y=(x−2)²−3 futhi wathi, "Okuncane kakhulu ngu-−3." Kodwa kuye ngenkinga, ibanga lamanani x angawathatha nalo liyashintsha. Esinyathelweni ngasinye, ibanga (njengo-x ngu-3 noma ngaphezulu futhi ngu-6 noma ngaphansi) nethebula lamanani ka-y atholwe ngokufaka amanani ambalwa ka-x kuboniswa kabusha. Cabanga ngazo zonke izinombolo zangempela x ngaphakathi kwebanga.
z-m-19-03.thinking.0: Ukugcina noma ukuvuselela isinqumo ngokwolwazi olusha
z-m-19-03.thinking.1: Ukuhlukanisa ngamacala ngokuthi i-vertex ingaphakathi noma ingaphandle kwebanga
z-m-19-03.thinking.2: Ukwenza wena ibanga elifanelana nezimo nokuhlola inani
z-m-19-03.prereq.0: Ukufunda i-vertex ne-axis ye-symmetry yomsebenzi we-quadratic y=a(x−p)²+q (izinga leBanga 9)
z-m-19-03.prereq.1: Ukufaka inani lika-x esishweni ukuthola inani lika-y
z-m-19-03.s.s1.prompt: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, hlulela ukuthi kwenzekani esitatimendeni sika-Doha 'okuncane kakhulu ngu-−3' kuye ngebanga lika-x.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuthi inani elincane kakhulu lika-y ethebuleni liba kuphi x nokuthi leyo x isebangeni.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.hint.1: Faka x engekho ethebuleni (isibonelo, 2.5 noma 3.5) esishweni futhi uhlole ukuthi iba ncane kunamanani asethebuleni.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Ibanga: x yizo zonke izinombolo zangempela. Isisho: y=(x−2)²−3. Ithebula lamanani (x → y): 0 → 1, 1 → −2, 2 → −3, 3 → −2, 4 → 1.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Liyini inani elincane kakhulu lalo msebenzi?
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.after: (x−2)²≥0, ngakho y≥−3, futhi uma x=2, y=−3. Ethebuleni futhi, inani elincane kakhulu ngu-−3 ku-x=2.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ukhethe inani ekugcineni kakhulu kwethebula. Qhathanisa ukuthi inani elincane kakhulu lika-y kulo lonke ithebula liphi.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Umile eduze kuka-x=1 noma x=3. Qhathanisa nenani ku-x=2.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Noma x iyinombolo yangempela noma iyiphi, (x−2)² ayincipha ngaphansi kuka-0. Hlola ukuthi inani lehla ngokungapheli yini.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Isimo esisha: ibanga lika-x lishintshe laba ngu-0≤x≤5. Ithebula lamanani (x → y): 0 → 1, 1 → −2, 2 → −3, 3 → −2, 4 → 1, 5 → 6.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ibanga selibe lincane. Uzohlulela ini ngokuncane kakhulu?
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.after: x=2 isebangeni, ngakho u-−3 usengaphuma, futhi ngenxa yesimo sesisho, (x−2)²≥0, ayincipha ngaphansi kuka-−3 noma ku-x engekho ethebuleni. Noma ngolwazi olusha, isinqumo singahlala sinjalo. Ukusho ngethebula kuphela ukuthi 'kunzima ukuqiniseka' kwakuwukuqapha okunengqondo nakho.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Kuyashintsha. Okuncane kakhulu ngu-y=1 ekugcineni kwesobunxele kwebanga, x=0
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ucabange ukuthi uma ibanga lishintsha, isiphetho siba okuncane kakhulu. Hlola ethebuleni ukuthi inani ku-x=2 lisebangeni yini.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Kunzima ukuqiniseka ngethebula kuphela. Kungaba kuncane kuno-−3 ku-x engekho ethebuleni
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Kuyashintsha. Okuncane kakhulu ngu-y=6 ekugcineni kwesokudla kwebanga, x=5
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ukhethe inani ekugcineni kwesokudla. Qhathanisa nenani elincane kakhulu ethebuleni.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Isimo esisha: ibanga lika-x lishintshe laba ngu-3≤x≤6 (x=2 ye-vertex ayisebangeni). Ithebula lamanani (x → y): 3 → −2, 4 → 1, 5 → 6, 6 → 13.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.after: x=2 ingaphandle kwebanga, ngakho u-−3 ngeke aphume. Ngaphakathi kwebanga, y iba nkulu njengoba x iba nkulu, ngakho okuncane kakhulu u-−2 kuphuma ku-x=3 osesobunxeleni kakhulu.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Leli yinani ku-x=2. Hlola ukuthi leyo x isebangeni.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Leli yinani eliphakathi lethebula. Qhathanisa futhi ukuthi inani elincane kakhulu lika-y ethebuleni liphi.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ukhethe inani elikhulu kakhulu ethebuleni. Hlola futhi ukuthi okuncane kakhulu kuyini.
z-m-19-03.s.s1.reflect: Isinqumo sokuqala, 'inani lika-y le-vertex liyinto encane kakhulu,' silungile kuphela uma x ye-vertex isebangeni. Njengasesinyathelweni sesi-2, isinqumo singahlala sinjalo noma ngolwazi olusha, futhi njengasesinyathelweni sesi-3, kumele uvuselele isinqumo uma isimo sishintsha. Okubalulekile ukubheka ukuthi yini eshintshile (ukuthi i-vertex ingaphakathi noma ingaphandle kwebanga) bese unquma ukugcina noma ukuvuselela.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.prompt: Ku-y=x²−4x+1, setha ibanga lika-x njengo-p≤x≤q (p, q izinombolo eziphelele, −4≤p<q≤8) ukuze x=2 ye-vertex ibe ngaphandle kwebanga. Bhala nokuncane kakhulu m kuleli banga. Yenza amabanga angu-2 ahlukene.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.hint.0: Phawula emgqeni wezinombolo ukuthi p no-q kumele babe ohlangothini luni lwe-2 ukuze ibanga lingafaki x=2.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.hint.1: Thola amanani ka-y kuma-x amabili ekugcineni kwebanga olikhethile bese uhlola ukuthi encane ilingana no-m yini.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.fail.c1: p no-q kumele babe yizinombolo eziphelele ezine-−4≤p<q≤8.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.fail.c2: x=2 iphakathi kuka-p no-q. Shintsha ibanga ukuze lingafaki u-2.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.fail.c3: m ayilungile. Thola amanani ka-y kuma-x amabili ekugcineni kwebanga bese uwaqhathanisa.
z-m-19-03.s.s2.explain: Uma x=2 ye-vertex ingaphandle kwebanga, y ishintsha kuphela ngohlangothi olulodwa ngaphakathi kwebanga. Ngakho okuncane kakhulu kuphuma ekugcineni okusondele ku-2. isb., ku-3≤x≤6, kungu-−2 ku-x=3; ku-−3≤x≤0, kungu-1 ku-x=0; ku-−4≤x≤1, kungu-−2 ku-x=1. Akukho cala lapho u-−3 uphuma.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.prompt: Komunye umsebenzi, y=−(x−1)²+4, ufuna ukuthola okuphezulu kakhulu uma ibanga lika-x lingu-−2≤x≤0. Yini efaneleke ukuyihlola kuqala?
z-m-19-03.s.s3.hint.0: Phawula u-−2, 0, no-x=1 we-vertex emgqeni wezinombolo.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi indawo lapho okuphezulu kakhulu kwenzeka ihluka kanjani kuye ngokuthi x ye-vertex isebangeni yini.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.o.a: Ngokushesha bhala u-4, inani lika-y le-vertex (1, 4), njengokuphezulu kakhulu
z-m-19-03.s.s3.r.a: Awuhlolanga ukuthi x ye-vertex isebangeni yini. Le yinkinga efanayo nesizathu sokuthi u-−3 ngeke aphume esinyathelweni sangaphambilini.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.o.b: Thola amanani ka-y ekugcineni kwamabili kwebanga, x=−2 no-x=0, bese ukhetha elikhulu
z-m-19-03.s.s3.r.b: Kulo msebenzi nebanga impendulo efanayo iyaphuma, kodwa iyindlela engaphutha inani le-vertex uma i-vertex isebangeni.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.o.c: Igrafu iqonde phezulu, ngakho qala uthole okuncane kakhulu
z-m-19-03.s.s3.r.c: Okubuzwayo okuphezulu kakhulu, ngakho ungase uxubanise ubudlelwano phakathi kwesiqondiso sejika nokuphezulu nokuncane kakhulu.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.o.d: Qala ubheke ukuthi i-x-coordinate 1 ye-vertex isebangeni −2≤x≤0 yini
z-m-19-03.s.s3.explain: x=1 ayisebangeni −2≤x≤0, ngakho okuphezulu kakhulu akusona u-4 we-vertex. Ngaphakathi kwebanga, y iba nkulu njengoba x iba nkulu, ngakho okuphezulu kakhulu ngu-y=3 ku-x=0, futhi ku-x=−2 ngu-−5. Uma i-vertex isebangeni, inani le-vertex liyikhethiwe; uma ingaphandle, amanani ekugcineni ayikhethiwe.
z-m-19-03.s.s3.acc.0: Kulo msebenzi nebanga, x=1 ye-vertex ingaphandle kwebanga, ngakho indlela yokuqhathanisa ekugcineni kwamabili nayo inikeza impendulo efanayo, 3. Nokho, ezinye izinkinga lapho i-vertex isebangeni, ungaphutha inani le-vertex, ngakho umkhuba wokuqala ubheke indawo ye-vertex uphephile kakhulu.

z-m-19-04.title: Ingabe ama-engeli angaphakathi ku-arc yobude obufanayo ayalingana?
z-m-19-04.topic: Ama-engeli angaphakathi nobude be-arc: ama-engeli angaphakathi ku-arc yobude obufanayo
z-m-19-04.goal: Thola umugqa ophutha encazelweni 'uma ubude be-arc bulingana, ama-engeli angaphakathi ayalingana,' thola ama-engeli angaphakathi enziwe yi-arc yobude obufanayo ezindingilizini ezine-radius ehlukile, bese usho isimo lapho isicelo sisebenza khona.
z-m-19-04.material: Isiyingi O sine-radius engu-6 cm, futhi isiyingi O' (O prime) sine-radius engu-12 cm. I-arc AB esiyingini O ne-arc CD esiyingini O' zombili zinobude obungu-4π cm, futhi i-arc ngayinye incane kunesiyingi sehhafu. U-Doyun uthe, "Ama-engeli angaphakathi ku-arc yobude obufanayo ayalingana," futhi wachaza kanje. (I-engeli engaphakathi ∠APB yi-engeli lapho iphoyinti P esiyingini, ohlangothini olungelona i-arc AB, libuka u-A no-B, futhi ∠CQD kufana. ∠APB ifundwa 'angle APB'.)
z-m-19-04.thinking.1: Ukwenza izibonelo zezinombolo eziningana ukubona isakhiwo sesibonelo esiphikisayo
z-m-19-04.thinking.2: Ukusho isimo lapho isicelo sisebenza khona
z-m-19-04.prereq.0: Usayizi we-engeli engaphakathi ku-arc uyingxenye yosayizi we-engeli ephakathi ku-arc leyo (izinga leBanga 9)
z-m-19-04.prereq.1: Ubude be-arc 2πr×(x/360) ye-engeli ephakathi x° esiyingini se-radius r (izinga leBanga 7)
z-m-19-04.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa encazelweni ka-Doyun ongenakwethenjwa. (Kungcono ukukhetha umugqa wokuqala ophutha, kodwa ungakhetha nomugqa lapho kubhalwe isiphetho esingalungile ngenxa yawo.)
z-m-19-04.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuthi umugqa ngamunye ulandela ngqo kulowo owandulela, futhi unake ukuthi ama-radius ezindingilizi ezimbili ayafana noma ayahluka.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ngokwehlukana ukuthi i-engeli ephakathi ye-arc yobude obungu-4π imangaki ama-degree esiyingini ngasinye bese uziqhathanisa.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.line.0: Isiyingi O sine-radius engu-6, isiyingi O' sine-radius engu-12, futhi ama-arc AB no-CD zombili zinobude obungu-4π.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.line.1: Ubude be-arc buyalingana, ngakho osayizi bama-engeli aphakathi ama-arc amabili nabo bayalingana.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.line.2: I-engeli engaphakathi iyingxenye ye-engeli ephakathi, ngakho ∠APB no-∠CQD nazo ziyalingana.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho ama-engeli angaphakathi ku-arc yobude obufanayo ahlale elingana.
z-m-19-04.s.s1.explain: Umugqa wokuqala ophutha ngumugqa 2. Ubude be-arc bunqunywa yi-radius ne-engeli ephakathi ndawonye, ngakho ezindingilizini ezimbili ezine-radius ehlukile, noma ubude bulingana, ama-engeli aphakathi ayahluka. Esiyingini O, 4π=2π×6×(x/360) inikeza i-engeli ephakathi engu-120°, futhi esiyingini O', 4π=2π×12×(x/360) inikeza i-engeli ephakathi engu-60°. Ngakho ama-engeli angaphakathi ahluka, 60° no-30°. 'I-engeli engaphakathi iyingxenye ye-engeli ephakathi' emugqeni 3 yisitatimende esilungile, kodwa ithatha umphumela womugqa 2, ngakho isiphetho siphutha, futhi umugqa 4 ufana. Umugqa 1 yisimo esinikeziwe, ngakho awunankinga.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.prompt: Esiyingini se-radius r cm kunge-arc yobude obungu-4π cm (isiyingi sehhafu noma esincane). Thola i-engeli engaphakathi θ (ama-degree) kule-arc, bese wenza izindingilizi ezingu-3 ezine-radius ehlukile. (r ivela ku-4 kuya ku-30, futhi bhala u-r no-θ njengamanani aqondile.)
z-m-19-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala uthole i-engeli ephakathi ye-arc yobude obungu-4π esiyingini sika-r=6, bese uthola i-engeli engaphakathi kuyo.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala u-r no-θ ethebuleni bese ufuna ukuthi umphumela noma isamba samanani amabili esimisiwe.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.fail.c1: r kumele ibe kusukela ku-4 kuya ku-30.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Iyi-engeli engaphakathi efanelana nobude be-arc obungu-4π.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.fail.c2: I-engeli ephakathi ingu-2θ. Hlola ukuthi ubude be-arc 2πr×(2θ/360) bungu-4π yini. Khetha r enikeza inani eliqondile, hhayi eliphoqiwe.
z-m-19-04.s.s2.explain: I-engeli ephakathi ingu-2θ, ngakho ubude be-arc bungu-2πr×(2θ/360)=πrθ/90. Uma lokhu kungu-4π, khona rθ=360. Uma r=6, θ=60; uma r=12, θ=30; uma r=9, θ=40; uma r=4, θ=90. Noma ngobude be-arc obufanayo, uma i-radius inkulu, i-engeli engaphakathi incane.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.prompt: Chazela u-Doyun. Yimuphi isimo esengeziwe esidingekayo ukusho ukuthi ama-engeli angaphakathi ku-arc ezimbili zobude obufanayo ayalingana? Futhi kungani aba lingana ngaphansi kwalesi simo?
z-m-19-04.s.s3.hint.0: Bheka ukuthi θ iyini uma r ifana ethebuleni ku-s2.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi yimuphi phakathi kobude be-arc, i-radius ne-engeli ephakathi okumele ufane ukuze ama-engeli angaphakathi alingane.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uhlolé ukuthi isimo osibhalile sikhipha zonke izibonelo owazenza ku-s2 (izindingilizi ezine-radius ehlukile)?
z-m-19-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uchaze 'ukuthi kungani aba lingana' ngokuhlobene ne-engeli ephakathi?
z-m-19-04.s.s3.model.0: Ama-arc amabili kumele abe esiyingini esifanayo (noma izindingilizi ezine-radius efanayo). Uma i-radius ifana, khona uma ubude be-arc bulingana ama-engeli aphakathi ayalingana, futhi i-engeli engaphakathi iyingxenye ye-engeli ephakathi, ngakho ayalingana.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.model.1: Isimo sokuthi ama-radius ayafana siyadingeka. Uma ehluka, njengo-6 no-12, ama-engeli aphakathi ayahluka, 120° no-60°, ngakho ama-engeli angaphakathi angu-60° no-30°. Nge-radius efanayo, i-engeli ephakathi ilingana ngqo nobude be-arc, ngakho ama-engeli angaphakathi nawo ayalingana.
z-m-19-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ukusho 'ama-engeli aphakathi ayalingana' esikhundleni sika-'ubude be-arc' kuyiqukethe efanayo.
